scripts.services: docker compose up -d postgres neo4j redis
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: node init && cd backend && celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev: node init && npm-run-all services --parallel dev:backend dev:worker dev:frontend
scripts.dev:nodocker: node init && npm-run-all --parallel dev:backend dev:worker dev:frontend
scripts.dev:frontend-only: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:mono: node init && concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,yellow,magenta "cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd backend && celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
